name: 2023-1c-recuperatorio
title: Driving assistant V2: lane sensor, turn signal and fuel consumption mode
description: Starting from the working driving assistant (manual, automatic and assisted-manual modes reacting to a front proximity sensor), the student must add a lane position sensor and turn signal handling (lane-departure beep or steering correction depending on the mode, plus a beep when the signal stays on for too long while going straight) and a fuel consumption mode (aggressive, normal, economic) that determines the acceleration sent to the driving system when speeding up.

design.notes: The new lane behaviour must be spread over the existing DrivingMode hierarchy (manual beeps, automatic steers, assisted-manual combines both), the turn signal introduces time-dependent state (signal on for 2 minutes / more than 1 minute while going straight, modelled with GregorianDateTime) and the consumption mode adds a third polymorphic axis whose accelerate: only applies in the safe/no-object case of two of the three modes; all 21 provided tests must keep passing.
